intro: CyraOps deliberately does not sell the capabilities below; formal academies are folded into our Team enablement offer rather than sold as a school, and each excluded item is declined or handed to a partner.

items.reason: We cannot staff quantum physicists and we do not claim quantum computing or frontier-scale research; classical optimisation and forecasting stay in scope.
We decline HIPAA-regulated clinical, payer and pharma work because we cannot staff those practices in week one; we partner instead of claiming the vertical.
We do not staff formulation scientists, recipe and bench testing or consumer-goods R&D models, so CPG product innovation work is declined.
Underwriting and credit decisions stay with the client; we cannot staff regulated P&C decisioning, actuarial models, KYC/AML or loan decisioning.
We do not operate commerce platforms; commerce analytics stay in scope but running the Cogentiq eCommerce platform is excluded.
We do not run a staffing practice, so the iqigai recruiting platform and talent-acquisition operations are out of scope.
Continued pre-training and frontier-scale model training are out of scope; we customise existing models via fine-tuning, RAG and evaluation instead.
We do not implement or run ERP systems; we build data and AI capabilities that connect to them, but ERP deployment itself is out of scope.
